notes.title: Demo Release
notes.notes:
🔹 Think Fast- Launch tetrominos into a nuclear core.

🔹 Use the X-Ray Drop- Create massive chains while balancing your core to avoid a meltdown.

🔹 Reaktor Vibes- Become a Nuclear Control Engineer, and take control of a Soviet-era reactor.

🔹 Multiplayer- Demo supports up to four friends!


If you're a fan of classic tetromino games and want a new challenge, play the free Reaktor demo NOW!
